analogy.rationale: PDGFRA is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose expression is low in most of these cell lines, so PDGFR inhibitors should elicit little transcriptional response; other RTK inhibitors (VEGFR, EGFR, FLT3) share downstream signaling and would be the closest analogs, though they too act on receptors with limited expression in these cells.
